FIELDS.NAME: Value Mart
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Value Mart operates as a general merchandise store, offering a wide selection of new consumer goods including household items, clothing, toys, and personal care products. Our primary revenue source is in-store sales, complemented by a modest online presence. We take pride in maintaining strong inventory management and loss prevention procedures, which include regular audits and employee training to ensure customer satisfaction. Our staff is trained in customer service and emergency procedures to enhance the shopping experience while ensuring operational safety. We engage with reputable vendors and suppliers, ensuring all products meet safety standards and regulatory requirements. Our store is equipped with adequate security measures, including surveillance systems, secure storage, and clear emergency protocols, providing a safe environment for both customers and employees.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Theft by unknown suspect on 05/15/2023, resulting in a loss of $1,500; currently under investigation. Water damage incurred from a burst pipe on 08/20/2023, leading to losses amounting to $800; repairs completed and status resolved.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Steel safe, Class B, UL listed, with fire resistance rating of 1 hour.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security personnel on-site during operating hours, monitored by Central Station alarm system and equipped with CCTV surveillance.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Value Mart does not engage in storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials as part of its operations. The store focuses on a wide range of consumer goods and adheres to safety and regulatory standards.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – Value Mart does not sponsor any athletic teams as part of its business operations. Our focus remains on providing a wide range of consumer goods in-store and online.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Subcontractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance (COI). The responsibility for checking certificates typically falls to the business owner or a designated manager within the organization.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – The applicant has not been indicted or convicted of any degree of the crime of fraud, bribery, arson, or any other arson-related crime in connection with this or any other property.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Value Mart has not had any policy or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior three years. All previous insurance policies have been maintained without issue.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Value Mart does not lease employees to or from other employers. All employees are directly hired and managed by the store.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Value Mart carries Workers' Compensation insurance as required, ensuring compliance with statutory obligations for employee coverage.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: No – Value Mart does not own or operate any other business. The store focuses solely on its general merchandise operations.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Value Mart currently does not have any other insurance policies with this company aside from the existing policy listed. All insurance coverage is contained within this policy.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Value Mart is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. The store solely operates as a retail outlet for a wide selection of consumer goods.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Value Mart does not rent or loan equipment to others, focusing solely on retail sales of consumer goods. This helps maintain our operational focus and minimizes liability risks.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – The applicant has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Value Mart does not have exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals in its operations. The store focuses on retailing general merchandise, ensuring compliance with safety standards and regulations.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Value Mart does not have any identified catastrophe exposure, as its operations primarily involve retailing consumer goods without significant risks associated with natural disasters or other catastrophic events. The store is equipped with safety and security measures to mitigate potential risks.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Value Mart has not had any past losses or claims related to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. The business maintains a strong commitment to compliance and employee training.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Value Mart confirms that there are no uncorrected fire code violations at the store. We regularly ensure compliance with fire safety standards to maintain a safe environment for customers and employees.
